extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: sci-fi data pad (tablet), 25 x 17 cm, 1.7 cm thick
extras.notes: lies flat with the screen facing up, bottom edge of the screen towards -Y; white top shell and grey bottom shell with a real parting seam, slightly raised screen with abstract wave, bars and status bar (emissive, no text, no digits), three colour buttons, status LED, speaker dots and a lilac stylus in a groove on the back edge; no moving parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
